plan.title: AD lesional vs control hallmark GSEA (Python)
plan.analytical_narrative:
The research question asks only which hallmark pathways are enriched in the treated (atopic dermatitis lesional skin) versus control contrast, and the DESeq2 results table for exactly that contrast is already provided (/eval-full-32-with-python-enrichment-only-2/data/inputs/results/de_results.csv, 12000 genes x 8 columns, gene symbols). Differential expression therefore does not need re-running, and the plan starts from the supplied statistics as the user asked.

Step T1S1 validates and ranks: it reads de_results.csv, checks that the Wald statistic column is present and usable, quantifies how many genes carry NA statistics (DESeq2 sets p to NA for Cook's-distance outliers and for independently filtered genes), reports how many genes pass padj < 0.05, and writes a single full ranked list of every tested gene. The ranking metric is the DESeq2 Wald statistic — the disputed choice R-0108 resolved toward the side that scales the effect by its standard error, which is the right choice here because the cohort is small (6 vs 6) and one sample (sample_01) has a library size about 4x below the median, so unshrunken fold changes for low-count genes would be noisy. No thresholding is applied before the enrichment test.

Step T2S1 runs preranked GSEA with gseapy against the human MSigDB hallmark collection (50 HALLMARK_* sets, HGNC symbols — the identifier space of de_results.csv, so no ID conversion is needed and none should be invented), gene-set size window 15-500 after intersection with the tested genes, BH adjustment, fixed seed. It reports NES, FDR q, and leading-edge genes per set, and collapses sets whose leading edges overlap heavily so that one shared signal is not reported as several findings.

Step T1S3 assembles the report: the ranked hallmark table, leading edges, the collection version, the rank metric, the universe (the tested genes of de_results.csv), the size window, the number of DE genes at padj<0.05, the unmapped/NA share, and the caveat that enrichment results are method-dependent and that hallmark sets are hypotheses for follow-up, not mechanism. Everything is Python; no R is used anywhere.

Counts.csv and metadata.csv are not needed for the question as posed and are not re-analysed; the low-depth sample_01 caveat is carried forward as an interpretation caveat on the supplied DE statistics rather than as a re-filtering decision.

steps.method: gseapy preranked GSEA on the DESeq2 Wald statistic against MSigDB human hallmark
Markdown report with leading-edge genes, collection version, rank metric, universe, size window, reproducibility record
